body:
Refresh ALL native-integration install/setup documentation across the marketing + docs site (apps/docs) so it reflects the CURRENT native integration implementations. Most install procedures pre-date the recent native flushes (codex/opencode/pi/cursor/antigravity) and the universal-installer work (ADR 0009), and several show stale "no published package, work from a checkout" steps that are no longer the recommended path.

=== SOURCE OF TRUTH ===
apps/docs/lib/integration-facts.mjs is the single source that drives the marketing integration pages (apps/docs/app/(home)/integrations/*) — each integration's `install` array + `status` + `note`. There is a test (apps/docs/test/*) that cross-checks it against docs/integrations/<slug>.md. The docs-content integration pages live at apps/docs/content/docs/integrations/<slug>.mdx and getting-started.mdx also carries install steps.

=== DELIVERABLES ===
1. For EACH integration (claude-code, codex, cursor, opencode, pi, antigravity), determine the CURRENT correct install path by grounding against the repo: the plugin's package.json (publishConfig/name — is it on npm now?), its README, the marketplace manifest (.agents/plugins/marketplace.json / .claude marketplace), the scaffold/init CLI it ships, and ADR 0009 (universal install via npx plugins). Update integration-facts.mjs `install`/`status`/`note` to the current recommended path (e.g., a published `npx @adlc/<harness> init` or `<harness> install ...` where it now exists, instead of "clone the repo"). Do NOT invent a published package that does not exist — if a harness is still source-only, say so accurately, but remove steps that are wrong/outdated.
2. Reconcile the docs-content integration pages (apps/docs/content/docs/integrations/<slug>.mdx) and getting-started.mdx so their install/setup sections match integration-facts.mjs (no contradictory or stale procedures between the marketing page and the docs page for the same harness).
3. Add @adlc/fleet to the site's integration/toolkit story where appropriate: note that the fleet can now orchestrate parallel workers across the native harnesses (the T44 adapter registry), on the fleet toolkit page and/or the integrations index — accurately (mark forward-looking parts as such if the multi-harness adapters are not yet published).
4. Keep the marketing pages truthful: every documented command must be a real, current path (respect the existing docs guards — the toolkit dispatcher/bijective tests).

=== ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (each independently verifiable) ===
- AC1 (facts current & grounded): each integration's install steps in integration-facts.mjs are the current recommended path, VERIFIED against that plugin's actual state (package.json publishConfig/name, README, marketplace manifest, scaffold CLI). VERIFY: for each slug, the install commands correspond to a real mechanism present in the repo/registry; no "clone from a checkout" step remains where a published/native path now exists.
- AC2 (docs tests green): `node --test apps/docs/test/*.test.mjs` exits 0 (the integration-facts↔docs cross-check, the bijective toolkit test, and the dispatcher test all pass).
- AC3 (marketing ↔ docs consistency): for each harness, the install steps on the marketing integration page (driven by integration-facts.mjs) and the docs-content integration page (content/docs/integrations/<slug>.mdx) agree — no contradictory procedures. VERIFY: diff the two per harness; they describe the same current path.
- AC4 (build): `cd apps/docs && npm run build` succeeds (the site compiles with the updated content). If a full build is infeasible offline, VERIFY the MDX/data parse via the docs test suite and a lint/typecheck.
- AC5 (fleet mentioned accurately): the fleet's multi-harness orchestration is referenced on the site (toolkit/fleet page or integrations index) without over-claiming — forward-looking capabilities marked as such. VERIFY: grep the site for a fleet multi-harness reference; confirm it is accurate to the current published state.

Suppressions denied. Scope: apps/docs/**, docs/integrations/**. Rails: []. Out of scope: redesigning the site; changing the toolkit dispatcher/bijective guards; publishing new packages. This ticket is documentation accuracy only — do not change plugin/package code to match the docs; change the docs to match reality.
title: Refresh all native-integration install docs across the marketing + docs site to current native paths
